thaumicenergistics.research_page.TEINFUS:
Setting up pedestals for every infusion is slow work. You locked a runic matrix inside an assembler frame, so the network can infuse for you.
The infusion assembler crafts infusion recipes as network autocrafting: the network supplies the central item, the components and the essentia, the assembler returns the result. Sealed inside the frame, the matrix never becomes unstable.

Recipes are written to an §linfusion core§r in the §linfusion inscriber§r. Put the central item into the slot, pick the recipe with the arrow if it has several, and save it. The core then goes into the assembler.
Speed cards make the assembler work faster.
